description: a ring torus (tube radius 1 about a circle of radius 3, revolved whole about z) drilled through its tube by a cylinder of radius 0.4 parallel to the torus's axis and 3 from it, the edge where the bore leaves the tube's top at (3.4, 0, 0.9165) filleted at r 0.1: a torus against a cylinder off its axis, a quartic meeting no closed form of the table. The edge is two arcs at two vertices, each a walked stripe (ADR-0062), meeting at each vertex on the ball's arc there (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 5b). Arris builds it clean, its blend holding the ball at r from both faces to 3e-9 at 451 samples of each surface. Open CASCADE builds it as a walked B-spline whose ball misses the faces by 1.4e-4 at the median of the same samples and 5.6e-4 at worst, at its default approximation and at 1e-8 alike, so its area lies 4.2e-4 (3.4e-6 relative) and its volume 4.9e-5 (8.4e-7) below Arris'. The measure tolerances cover that miss, under ADR-0062's 1e-5 for a walked fixture (no closed form holds the blend)
